_doc: UCP agent profile of Jarvis 007. Shopify (and every store that speaks UCP) REQUIRES each tool call to carry meta['ucp-agent'].profile = a public HTTPS URL pointing at exactly this file, so the store can download it and negotiate capabilities (capability negotiation). Because the store must be able to download the file ITSELF, it cannot live on the machine running Jarvis 007 (usually localhost/LAN) - the canonical copy is served through GitHub raw, see the agent_profile field of the shopify connector in system/mcp-catalog.json. Jarvis 007 does NOT declare the checkout capability (dev.ucp.shopping.checkout): Jarvis 007 stops at the cart and hands the link to a real person to click.
